export type PaymentStatus = "paid" | "pending" | "refunded" | "failed";
export type FulfillmentStatus =
  | "unfulfilled"
  | "processing"
  | "shipped"
  | "delivered";
export type Channel = "Online store" | "Marketplace" | "Retail";

export interface Product {
  sku: string;
  name: string;
  detail?: string;
  price: number;
}

export interface OrderLine extends Product {
  quantity: number;
}

export interface Order {
  id: string;
  customer: string;
  email: string;
  placedAt: string;
  channel: Channel;
  payment: PaymentStatus;
  fulfillment: FulfillmentStatus;
  lines: OrderLine[];
  shipping: number;
  discount: number;
  tracking?: string;
  shipTo: string[];
}

  { id: "delivered", name: "Delivered" },

export function orderTotals(
  order: Pick<Order, "lines" | "shipping" | "discount">,
) {
  const subtotal = order.lines.reduce(
    (sum, item) => sum + item.price * item.quantity,
    0,
  );
  const tax = Math.round(subtotal * 0.0825);
  return {
    subtotal,
    tax,
    total: subtotal - order.discount + order.shipping + tax,
  };
}

export function itemCount(order: Pick<Order, "lines">) {
  return order.lines.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.quantity, 0);
}

const money = new Intl.NumberFormat("en-US", {
  style: "currency",
  currency: "USD",
});

const dayFormat = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", {
  month: "short",
  day: "numeric",
  timeZone: "UTC",
});

const timeFormat = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", {
  hour: "numeric",
  minute: "2-digit",
  timeZone: "UTC",
});

const fullDateFormat = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", {
  month: "short",
  day: "numeric",
  year: "numeric",
  timeZone: "UTC",
});

export function formatMoney(cents: number) {
  return money.format(cents / 100);
}

export function formatDay(value: string) {
  return dayFormat.format(new Date(value));
}

export function formatTime(value: string) {
  return timeFormat.format(new Date(value));
}

export function formatFullDate(value: string) {
  return fullDateFormat.format(new Date(value));
}
